A fixed effect can qualify even if it currently has no movement permission. A permanently creature/carried-object-attached effect is excluded rather than immobilizing its bearer. A class engine, whole creature, permanent item enchantment without a separate eligible ongoing application, completed instantaneous result or nonexistent aura is not a target. No rank cap or resistance roll is added once those real permissions are present.

NEW maintain one nonconcentration Seal for up to seven elapsed days, ending earlier when the protected application ends. Fix that application's spatial origin at its actual current world position. It loses authorized relocation/recentering while sealed, but keeps its actual source-permitted radius/shape evolution and unrelated effects; anchoring is not a frozen event clock or expanded shape permission. The parent's owner, rank, DC, concentration, duration, recipient set, charges, pulses, resource history and ordinary source-ending permissions remain. A one-minute parent still ends after its original minute. The Seal neither maintains another caster's concentration nor prevents their voluntary ending, source destruction, legitimate expiry or an independently specified non-dispel ending.

Normal dispelling cannot end the protected application or this Seal itself while protection operates, including an otherwise eligible Greater Dispel. A source explicitly overriding nondispellable/anchored protection retains only its real written scope; no high-rank automatic bypass is invented. Counterspell can stop the Seal before establishment. Actual suppression is distinct: it suspends the Seal's protection/anchor while the original seven-day clock continues. A separately legal dispel can then affect an otherwise eligible parent or Seal only if it can actually resolve through that suppression environment and its own normal rank/target rules. This creates no permission to cast inside antimagic or assume that a low-rank dispel can remove a rank-six Seal. If a mobile parent moves while the Seal is suppressed, on resumption the Seal fixes its then-current origin, not a backward teleport to the old point; this is a NEW specific resumption rule, with no renewed duration or lost-history reset.

One active Resonance Seal per caster. A genuinely established new Seal replaces that caster's old one, freeing the old parent's movement/ordinary dispel eligibility without ending it. Hidden failure/countering creates no replacement. The caster may end their Seal with an Action while personally perceiving its anchor within60feet and line of effect. Separate other casters' Seals retain their own original deadlines; fixing the same origin supplies no cumulative protection rank or added duration. A genuinely conflicting attempt to establish a second origin for an already immovable effect does not move that effect; its current actual position is the only admissible anchor.

NEW exclude Resonance Seal, Spell Seal and Resonance Anchor themselves from this spell's eligible targets, preventing cross-protection loops among these three families. The earlier Spell Seal proposal remains unadopted and unchanged. This draft proposes no automatic amendment to it: any later reciprocal exclusion requires its own explicit joint disposition. Only Resonance Seal targeting is defined here. Reviewed Resonance Anchor is unchanged and keeps its own normal dispellability. Compared with the distinct proposed Spell Seal, Resonance Seal has actual spatial anchoring, source-owner permission, one active caster slot and a seven-day maximum; Spell Seal proposes broader application targeting and a24-hour nondispel-only benefit. Neither is silently merged or renamed. No body, RP, charge, missed pulse, old effect or frozen lifetime is created by either name.

CURRENT TRANSPORT/CLOCK LIMIT: the target is one eligible spatial magical application, not a body, vehicle, entire plane or generated Banishment cell. Sealing an eligible portal anchor cannot suppress a mandatory independent closure/expiry or preserve its destination beyond the portal source. It cannot keep ordinary Banishment open or stop BAN-CLOSE-03. A later actual suppressor must establish suppression of this Seal before the protection ceases; mere intent, caster entry into an unrelated field, or a purported high-rank dispel does not supply that premise. Suppression does not by itself prove that a dispel can operate in the same location. AC5 Antimagic Field (Lesser) and Greater Dispel are now jointly accepted. Apply AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04: a Greater Dispel operation at an antimagic-suppressed Seal or parent locus is itself suppressed; the target-field self-exemption applies only to an operation targeting that Antimagic field. Snapshot all operations before any removals, with no same-cast rescan. Suppressing Seal therefore does not by itself establish a successful dispel route.

CURRENT EXECUTABLE REMOVAL CONCLUSION: apply AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01. The accepted Lesser Antimagic + Greater Dispel combination does not create a successful selective suppress-then-dispel route for Seal/parent at the same suppressed locus. Wizard class Dispel /cards/19 is a rank3 spell, not a magical nonspell.

exactAuthority.activationAndGeometry: KEEP Abjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and concentration up to60elapsed seconds. exactAuthority.eligibility: NEW PB-PRED-01, scoped only to this wall: a creature qualifies if an actual operative source explicitly classifies it as extraplanar, or an actual established native-plane relationship places its native plane elsewhere than the wall's plane. Without either affirmative established basis, this wall imposes no blocking branch; that operational absence is not proof the creature is native or non-extraplanar. Elemental, Fey, Fiend, Humanoid, summoned, outsider and extraplanar are not interchangeable labels. The Director may record a genuinely NEW campaign creature classification explicitly before play, but may not claim it was recovered from cosmology or infer it from a hidden soul theory.
exactAuthority.physicalCrossing: An operative panel blocks a qualifying creature's attempted voluntary or forced physical crossing at its boundary, including that body carried, dragged, grappled or ridden by another. Every separately transported creature retains its own eligibility; hiding a qualifying passenger under a cloak does not turn it into gear. Stop the actual crossing transaction before any qualifying body intersects the panel; no part is severed, squeezed through by changing its name, or left behind without an independently legal release. Movement used to reach the boundary remains spent; impossible remaining movement is not performed. A nonqualifying carrier can release the passenger through its actual available action and move alone if then legal. Nonqualifying bodies, ordinary objects, air, sound and actual attacks pass under their own rules. Going around a real edge remains possible. The wall deals no damage, imposes no extra save and grants no free force or opportunity attack. CURRENT EXPLICIT VERTICAL-FALL EXCEPTION: apply fallingAndPlacement below when gravity carries a body down through a top/bottom edge; the wall supplies no horizontal supporting face. This exception does not authorize lateral passage through an otherwise operative broad vertical face.
exactAuthority.fallingAndPlacement: Selective wall supplies no horizontal support. Unsupported Falling continues under the ordinary Fall Marker. QUALIFICATION-CHANGE branch: if an existing body becomes qualifying while intersecting an otherwise operative fixed5x5 panel, that entire panel is pending until no qualifying body intersects it; it supplies no blocking while pending. This whole-panel rule is for a body becoming qualifying inside an operative panel, not for antimagic clipping. NEW explicit completion for the existing no-platform promise: downward Falling through a top/bottom edge is not stopped by this selective wall. If that lawful vertical entry creates actual interior body overlap with a fixed panel, mark the whole intersected panel pending until qualifying bodies clear, exactly as for qualification-change occupancy. Other operative panels still block lateral crossing. A lateral forced movement component toward an operative face stops at its boundary while the independent unsupported vertical fall keeps its original marker/distance history. No support, extra save, impact damage or new Fall Marker is supplied by the wall itself.
exactAuthority.teleportAndTerminalReturn: The wall checks an actual transport destination footprint against its operative thickness for qualifying creature bodies; a destination that intersects is barred by this scoped magical endpoint-prevention rule. A fitting destination beyond the wall does not cross a fictitious physical path and is permitted unless another actual rule prevents that transport. An origin alone touching the wall does not bar leaving. Apply each transport source's normal atomic failure/payment rule. Ordinary Banishment's accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal return expressly overrides endpoint transport prevention: this wall cannot keep that ended cell open. It does not remove real terrain or other bodies. If that mandatory return legally places a qualifying body in the wall thickness, the occupied panel becomes pending under the rule above; no general voluntary-transit bypass is granted.
exactAuthority.suppressionAndEnding: The nonphysical ongoing rank6 wall has one parent and fixed5x5 panels. At resumption, each previously suppressed clear portion returns; an exact suppressed portion intersecting a qualifying body remains absent until clear. Unsuppressed portions were never removed. This clipped-portion rule is distinct from the qualification-change whole-panel pending rule. Losing actual ground support invalidates dependent panels for the remainder of this cast. One active Planar Barrier per caster. Expiry, concentration ending or eligible whole-source removal ends all panels.

Area mode applies the same independent willingness/save procedure to each creature occupant, while environmental records do not receive a creature's save. Resolve hidden willingness/protection/records only after legal costs, without an extra diagnostic report. For an admitted creature, end every actual qualifying removable Corruption effect currently on it, including all ordinary Corrupted condition sources and major nonintrinsic Corruption applications. This is not limited to one record or only minor records like Corruption Cleanse. A source calling its corruption permanent or giving it no ordinary expiry does not alone make it immune to this expressly stronger purge.

An explicit source-specific removal exception still governs: a unique record stating that only a named cure can remove it, that it cannot be cleansed by magic, or another actual protection applicable to this purge is not silently overridden by a generic higher rank. Keep the record and its exact unmet exception; do not relabel it minor, remove its hidden parent or claim whole-person purification. Innate ancestry, a class engine, intrinsic Oracle Curse/Burden and actual physiological changes that are now completed consequences rather than ongoing removable effects are not reclassified as targets. Corruption/Unity Exposure numeric tracks are not automatically active effect records; this spell supplies no unprinted track reset, historical alignment reversal, trait removal, HP healing, Wound cure, stabilization or resurrection. NEW for ordinary spatially divisible environmental Corruption, remove the operative intersection inside the sphere while retaining the same source's outside extent and actual remaining clock. Remove all admitted environmental records in the snapshot, not merely one chosen symptom. Source-specific automatic future reapplication retains its actual schedule; the purge grants no grace period, continuing aura or immunity and does not destroy a separate generator unless that generator itself was an eligible selected effect. If removing a parent already ends a captured child, do not process/award it twice or expand the snapshot to new recipients behind a disappeared barrier. currentIntegration.transportClassification: AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01: Conjuration8 crossings are planar transitions and teleportation for this spell only. This intentionally differs from accepted AC5 Alignment Portal.
currentIntegration.portalBodies: Each live mouth is a fixed physical 10-foot-wide by 15-foot-high aperture with exact pose. Whole-body entry and exit footprints must fit. The portal itself does not create difficult terrain. Actual terrain rate is 1/2/3 movement per foot, then crawling adds +1 per foot and squeezing +1 per foot. currentIntegration.planeBenefit: AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01 preserves the temporary destination-plane +2 aligned-recipient benefit while parent is live; this is spell metadata, not intrinsic plane alignment/cosmology.
currentIntegration.blockers: Actual accepted Dimensional Anchor tests the traveler transition endpoints, not portal formation. Other exact voluntary/teleport predicates use their own text. Closing the portal grants no free return; travelers remain where they actually are.
currentIntegration.durations: Divination6: concentration up to60 elapsed seconds. Conjuration8: concentration up to600 elapsed seconds. Each has its own absolute deadline from successful establishment; no shared 60-second portal deadline.

Divination6.formation: NEW fixed30foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within60feet and caster line of effect; concentration up to60elapsed seconds. The chosen center must be on the caster's actual current plane. Its insight benefit reaches eligible creatures with a body portion in the sphere and center-to-body line of effect, including the caster if eligible. It is a nonphysical magical zone, not illumination, cover, a wall or a new perception sense. It does not move with the caster.
Divination6.events: Check actual current plane, geometry, line of effect and effective alignment when each attack/save/task roll event is created. Entering/leaving, changing alignment or losing local eligibility changes future roll eligibility without a free new roll, spell cast or Action. No entry pulse, charge reserve, duration gift or lasting buff is acquired. Extra turns can contain genuine eligible rolls but create no special bonus budget. Partial local suppression removes only the affected current benefit; its clock and parent concentration continue.
Divination6.ending: Ordinary expiry, concentration ending, replacement or an actual eligible whole-source removal ends the zone. It has one rank6 parent record, not a list of separately cast spells. A fixed zone with no independent creature-target branch is ineligible for Xi's creature-branch ending. It gives no distant roll readout or retroactive revision of a completed roll.

Conjuration8.destinationAndSourceChoice: NEW full portal operation, not an insight zone substituted for travel. Choose an actually different plane and a specific destination place whose real physical layout the caster has personally perceived, either by visiting or through a source-authorized ordinary visual view such as Planar Window. A mere map name, secondhand direction, imagined ideal, omen or invented cosmology is insufficient to locate an endpoint. The Director records genuine stable origin/destination plane identities privately; distinct labels alone cannot pass the different-plane condition. Choose exact two opening faces and arrival spaces before commitment. Unknown or changed real destination conditions are resolved after paid commitment with no diagnostic report or substitute plane.
Conjuration8.newEmpowermentInterpretation: NEW consequential interpretation for joint review: the spell temporarily makes the selected destination plane empower creatures matching the cast's snapshotted pair, rather than requiring or asserting that the plane is eternally aligned. While this Nexus operates, its +2 insight benefit applies to every actually eligible creature physically on that destination plane, including preexisting inhabitants and enemies, whenever a qualifying roll occurs. This is deliberately plane-wide to retain the full destination-empowerment promise; it is not reduced to a receiving-pad buff. Evaluate it on actual roll events, without scanning or revealing a population. This temporary magical effect establishes no permanent planar affinity, creation history, soul jurisdiction, objective Wheel mapping, rest rule or moral allegiance. The scope and interpretation are NEW and unadopted, requiring explicit GPT review and later balance assessment.
Conjuration8.openings: NEW concentration up to600elapsed seconds. Form two fixed, visible vertical rectangular openings, each10feet wide and15feet high, linked face-to-face with a recorded neutral orientation. The whole origin opening and its five-foot-deep receiving clearance must be within120feet and caster line of effect. The remote opening/receiving clearance use the exact known destination layout rather than imaginary cross-plane line of effect. Both openings initially need actual unoccupied clear physical aperture volume and a front-side receiving region at least10feet wide,15feet high and5feet deep. A larger traveler needs additional actual receiving clearance at transit. An unsupported but otherwise empty fitting destination is permitted; the spell creates no floor, flight, breathing protection or environmental immunity. A traveler arriving without real support immediately follows its actual Falling/other movement rules. A hidden failure prevents the complete portal pair and empowerment after costs are committed. The spell creates no body in the gap and no third intermediate transit plane.
Conjuration8.transit: While both mouths are operative, a whole actual body may cross by spending five feet of available real movement from an adjacent reachable side; the body and its carried noncreature gear must fit the opening and legal receiving space. Ordinary physically permitted squeezing can apply if it truly allows that whole body through, without automatic resizing. Actual independent forced movement can carry a body through if that movement reaches/crosses the opening and all its own permissions remain legal; the Nexus itself compels nothing and grants no free movement. Separate riders/passengers/carried creatures remain separate bodies. A genuinely inseparable group declared by its actual transport situation is one atomic transaction and every body must fit and satisfy its own blockers. Otherwise bodies cross in a fixed actual event order and occupancy can stop later travelers. Real independent objects/projectiles can cross if they fit and possess actual movement/force. No remote stock is duplicated or pulled through merely by opening the gate. NEW receiving placement: before a particular transit commits, declare the receiving whole-body footprint/pose on the exit's front side, with the nearest edge of that footprint no more than5feet from the exit plane and every body point on the receiving side. It must be a real perceived or personally known location through the actual opening view, fit the current whole body/group and obey the declared exit orientation; it is not a remote retarget beyond the receiving space. Hidden/intervening occupancy is checked after a valid commitment and can defeat that paid movement without a substitute. All bodies retain their actual anatomy, dimensions, load and gear; no slot is reserved against other travelers. The five-foot minimum setup clearance alone does not prove that a Large or larger body fits.
Conjuration8.rangeSightAndAttacks: The open gateway transmits ordinary light and sound along the real unobstructed route through its two apertures. This is a view of the actual destination, not a remote caster body or origin substitution. NEW a genuinely physical nonspell projectile or thrust may pass through the opening with its own legal attack, visibility and remaining range: measure the actual route to the entrance plus from the exit, with zero additional path length for the paired mouth transition. The real attack retains its dealer/root, defenses and event identity. This includes a physical weapon with separately legal magical enhancement; it does not turn its attack into a second cast. A spell or other effect with an actual same-plane targeting/origin restriction keeps it; the gateway does not waive components, concentration, source-origin, target-type or planar limits or authorize casting from the remote mouth. An effect needs its own genuine authority for any nonphysical cross-plane delivery.
Conjuration8.preventionAndFailure: Test each actual transported body's origin and destination against applicable teleport/planar-transition prevention, including Dimensional Anchor, and the actual distinction between voluntary and involuntary travel in the preventing source. This operation is a planar transition and teleportation for these NEW Nexus transit rules; no imaginary intervening-world path is tested. A known invalid transit is not begun. If an obstacle/blocker becomes effective after a valid movement commitment, that transaction stays wholly at its actual origin with already-spent movement/resources retained; no nearest-safe relocation, new destination, partial body or retry occurs. Obstruction of a mouth can block a current transit without ending the entire spell. The gateway grants no universal ward bypass; ordinary Banishment's special terminal closure is unrelated to voluntary Nexus transit.
Conjuration8.suppressionAndClosure: Local suppression intersecting an opening makes that mouth unavailable for transit while the original clock continues. Local suppression at a beneficiary suspends only that creature's current insight expression. Suppression of the caster alone does not automatically end an already established concentration unless its actual source says so. An effect expressly suppressing the entire Nexus suspends both mouths and empowerment within its actual scope. Nothing queues missed moves or bonuses. On expiry, concentration ending, replacement or eligible parent removal, both mouths and all Nexus insight benefits end. Every completed traveler/object remains at its actual current location; there is no automatic return journey, refund or rescue. A transit resolves atomically before or after a closing event under actual event order, never half inside a severed body. If an endpoint's actual containing place ceases to exist, this Nexus ends rather than inventing a location to hold it. Existing source-specific mandatory body settlement remains that other source's responsibility.
Conjuration8.removalAndCustody: Both mouths are addressable manifestations of the same rank8 parent for an actually eligible dispel; ending the parent at either operative mouth ends both and the empowerment. It does not end an independent other Nexus. Plane-wide empowerment is one continuous zone-like effect with no independent creature-target branch, so Xi cannot end the whole plane effect by targeting an arbitrary beneficiary. Ordinary actually applicable narrow suppression/removal sources retain their own scope. All real cargo, bodies, personal custody, permits and institutional consequences remain real on the side where they are. Neither an unseen native population nor private plane facts are reported by the benefit.

NEW: a positive post-defense/pre-temporary-HP damage packet also ends this application after the already established hit/critical consequences; a fully prevented zero packet does not. Calm Emotions can subdue ordinary grief but its actual condition scope does not cure this Incapacitated record. Erase Emotion’s proposed anger/fear/pain choices likewise grant no generic Incapacitated cure; sorrow in this card is not a newly invented rage, Frightened or pain-condition tag. A source expressly removing this control can work within its real permissions. Later suppression retains the original clock, saves and spent guard. Ending never restores lost concentration or grants an action/refund. Independent source records remain separately removable; all applicable grief applications can observe the same real damage event without multiplying it.

CURRENT ENDING AND IMMUNITY BOUNDARY: A legal positive post-defense/pre-temp damage packet ends this application even when temporary HP absorbs it or Null changes its later lethal endpoint. Actual zero after pure prevention does not. An attack's already determined hit/critical outcome is not rerolled because grief ends afterward. If initial actual Incapacitated is prevented by immunity or spent hard control, no application or deferred emotion substitute establishes. Real class exceptions can prevent only the components their actual text names; no spell title grants a blanket concentration exception. When an established application ends, lost concentration and spent commands/resources stay lost. Source-only END save timing adds neither an owner phase nor ordinary death-save/recharge processing.

## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Commit the legal cast's RP, materials and other printed costs before any attack/save or interruption. Perform its components and establish concentration if required, ending incompatible prior concentration. An ordinary missed, saved-against or countered legal cast refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration.
5. At this cast's beginning, apply ordinary Dissonance and Refrain once: 0 base for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9; consecutive same-named casts add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3. First cast or a different name adds +0. Apply the class's exact protected reduction, routing or vent and any hook whose printed trigger is beginning/casting. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous name/Refrain unless the class expressly says so. This chronological commitment occurs before the Counterspell window; a later Reaction cast updates its own history, and resuming the earlier cast does not update that history again.
6. Open legal cast-interruption Reactions, resolving nested counters last-in, first-out. A surviving cast then resolves its effect: spell attacks are d20 + PB + the actual casting ability modifier; save DC is 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the exact card's hit/failure/success results and ordinary damage/conditions. Outcome-dependent class hooks occur only at their printed timing and with the required actual result. No automatic cantrip scaling applies. A negated spell grants no success/hit/damage effect merely because its casting cost was paid.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot supply an ungranted Action, duplicate concentration or resource reset. A readied spell commits this casting sequence at preparation; release has no second cast, cost, cadence update or Counterspell window.

Countering requires an actual operational spell or class card, its repertoire/access and a legal remaining Reaction. The ordinary Counterspell is now reviewed; it is separate from the Mage and Wizard class cards. Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) and Dispel Magic use their exact individual scopes. Rank-limited dispels inspect the original generating cast's spell rank, not RP cost or the dispeller's rank. Higher and unassigned source variants retain their own unfinished status.

## Falling bridge — new provisional procedure

This is a newly authored table procedure agreed with the GPT notebook, **not recovered V6/Core V2 canon**. Focused searches of the current rulebook extract, Core V2 and mechanics/manual text found spell summaries but no operational falling clock or impact formula. Before promotion to canon, inspect the approved V6 environment/travel/hazard sections and archived environment tables. Preserve any older rule found and compare it explicitly.

When a creature loses support with no movement mode or effect keeping it aloft, it enters **Falling** immediately. Falling means unsupported; it grants no hovering, airborne walking or lateral movement. Track total distance descended during this fall and cumulative distance during its current uncontrolled portion, both initially zero.

**Timing:** If a fall begins during a regular initiative turn, set a fixed Fall Marker at the **end of that initiative slot in the following round**. Resolve the first Falling Step there, then one at the same marker each round. Reactions and extra turns use the enclosing regular initiative slot; an event between slots uses the most recently completed slot. Extra turns, extra Actions and initiative changes neither move nor multiply the marker. This gives every participant one normal turn opportunity before the first descent; inability to act still matters and no free rescue action is granted. A caster still needs legal targets within range when spending their Action.

Outside initiative, when timing matters, establish an order before descent and use a virtual slot immediately before its first regular slot as the initiating slot. The first step occurs when that virtual slot next recurs, after everyone has had one normal turn opportunity. When no rescue or other timing decision is possible, the Director can resolve the same descent and impact calculation directly. This is an explicit timing abstraction, not a model of physical acceleration.

If a fall begins after initiative has been established but before any regular initiative slot has yet completed, treat the virtual pre-round slot as the most recently completed slot for Fall Marker purposes.

**Ordinary descent:** At each step descend up to **300 feet**, stopping on a supporting surface. Add the distance to both trackers. On landing while uncontrolled, take **min(10, floor(uncontrolled distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning damage**. The uncontrolled distance includes earlier steps; never use only the final step's remainder.

**Feather Fall:** The spell retains its **Action** casting time and reduces descent to at most **60 feet per step**. When it takes effect, set uncontrolled distance to zero: the magic dissipates prior uncontrolled momentum in this abstraction. Keep total fall distance. If landing while it remains active, damage is **min(3, floor(total fall distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning**. This explicitly limits impact exposure without guaranteeing a harmless landing. When the spell ends aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero, then accumulate ordinary descent from that point at the existing marker; expiry grants no immediate extra step. Its one-minute maximum ends immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting. If expiry and a step coincide, resolve expiry first. Earlier landing or cessation of Falling ends the spell on that target as printed.

Apply damage defenses only when their actual wording covers that damage. After damage, Falling ends; a creature suffering any positive falling damage lands **Prone** unless an explicit feature prevents it. Less than 20 relevant feet produces zero damage. Forced movement that removes support starts a fall but adds no separate fall damage. Regaining genuine support, secure support from a hold, or flight ends Falling without resolving an uncompleted impact; teleporting safely onto support likewise ends it. A later loss of support begins a new fall with new trackers and marker. Completed impact and damage cannot be undone by later casting.

| Scenario | Steps to land | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary 10 feet | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary 20 feet | 1 | 1d6 |
| Ordinary 300 feet | 1 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 310 feet | 2 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 610 feet | 3 | 10d6 |
| Feather Fall active through a 310-foot fall | 6 | 3d6 |
| 120 feet slowed, spell ends aloft, then 190 feet uncontrolled | 3 | 9d6 |

The 300-foot ordinary step, impact formulas, momentum reset, marker and duration conventions are provisional inventions. The source supplies Feather Fall's Action, five targets and 60-foot slowed descent. Wider hazards, equipment catches, flight loss and environmental damage still need the combat/campaign pass.

## Components, summons and ongoing effects

**V** requires audible speech; **S** requires a free hand or a class feature expressly permitting the gesture; **F** is the class's ordinary casting focus. Core's M/F shorthand is interpreted here as the existing focus alternative. No unspecified costly or consumed material is added. These hand/focus conventions are provisional and may require equipment integration. A spell with V is blocked by an effect explicitly preventing verbal casting.

Summon stat blocks use their printed AC/HP/attack die. Where absent, saves use the owner's PB, other ability checks use +0, walking Speed is 30 feet, and there are no unstated creature immunities or extraordinary senses. Unless a card explicitly gives another bounded range, a commanded companion must be within 60 feet and able to perceive its owner. All one owner's companions share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging action total per round**. Without a command they move and Dodge. A replacement requires the full casting cost. No summon grants loot, a reusable corpse or resource-generating death trigger.

The [rank-2 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK2_EXACT_REVIEW.md) approves this specific companion overlay: **when an exact companion source prints multiple attacks as one damaging action, those attacks are components of one commanded offensive action and consume the owner's single offensive-companion allowance unless that source expressly grants otherwise.** Summon Air Pet explicitly makes its two source attacks within that one action; no second command/action or remaining offense for another companion is created. Its fixed AC15/HP20/two 1d6 attacks do not inherit generic companion scaling.

Planar Ally (Minor) uses a finite NEW summon-only profile for the source's intended CR-1 role. The bounded public bestiary scan did not establish an eligible published exact-CR1 extraplanar creature; this card does not certify its CR or rewrite a bestiary entry. Summon Weaponry Satchel has finite conjured contents tied to one duration, with a narrow exception only for an already resolving immediate use. Alignment Weapon's suppression default applies only to that printed card.

Resonance Well rolls one 1d4 total reserve. Its separately named creation and receipt uses commit before prevention and reset only through each character's beneficial long rest. These limits neither share nor reset Kindle or Mod Rod records. Read the exact cards and [rank-2 status](CONJURATION_RANK2_REVIEW_STATUS.json); pricing/schema checks do not execute these effects or certify balance.

The [rank-3 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) adds seven bounded cards. Earth Pet's knockdown is Prone, not positional movement; generic push/pull immunity does not automatically prevent it. Burst of Flamewind affects every creature the caster ordinarily classifies as an enemy at a known location in its cone, with automatic source damage and a save controlling only its push.

Elemental Displacement selects a nearby willing recipient and a perceived destination; its teleport path is not constrained by intervening terrain. Spectral Steed actually crosses planes to a known site, once per steed attempt. Its 350-pound **and** 12-Load limits count the rider's body and all gear, including melded equipment. The reviewed correction from the conference's proposed6Load avoids excluding all gear from a Medium rider; ordinary Burdened applies at6Load. Read the exact mount/command/arrival procedure; it does not close general mounted combat.

Resonance Conduit transfers already-existing RP between two separate pools, with committed deductions, gated credit, and no resource creation or daily-ledger reset. Renewed consent cannot revive an ended application, but a new legal paid cast may create a new one. Faction Portal provides actual one-way travel to a known HQ on the same or another plane. Its positive-standing predicate uses the current canonical reputation record without migrating its scale. Travel may bypass a geographic route; elapsed clocks, cargo custody, contamination, claims, arrival law and settlement remain actual procedures. These cards do not declare automatic Extraction success or invent a blanket prohibition on planar escape. [Review status](CONJURATION_RANK3_REVIEW_STATUS.json) preserves the manuscript/runtime/balance distinction.

 Noncombat helpers cannot attack or operate combat items.

A cantrip that stabilizes restores no HP and removes no Wound. Mending cannot replace finite machine repair or refresh ammunition, charges, duration or class resources. Created tools, servants and water obey the explicit card limits; a spell does not silently pay wages, produce saleable materials or erase abstract expedition Supply.

All hard whole-Action/turn denial uses one combined **source-character/target/encounter** record across that character's spells, class features and companions. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. Temporary HP never add together. Copies never generate copies, class procs or resource loops.

## Mark Omen and Fate Coin: reviewed spell-specific rerolls

Mark Omen and Fate Coin share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from either of these two spells, across all casters, coins, marks and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these two spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use a fixed neutral table order chosen before the roll. Only the first legal commitment spends a mark/coin; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice.

The [rank-1 Divination exact review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_DIVINATION_RANK1_EXACT_REVIEW.md) requires Fate Coin to wait until the **complete original roll event** is rolled and its faces are available under normal table information rules. It then replaces only one chosen die before consequences apply. Mark Omen replaces the caster’s complete attack d20 procedure before hit/miss resolution. Neither creates another attack/cast, rerolls an established resource reserve, reverses applied consequences or duplicates costs/hooks. A Well’s initial reserve die may be changed before the reserve is established. These two spell grants do not rewrite the Oracle, Mirrorsage or other class reroll contracts.

The same review preserves actual distant hearing, concealed-entrance revelation, creature sight through non-solid obscurity, willing memory-sharing, and actual faction/alignment/Corruption information. Warning Ward uses established hostility and an entry-triggered six-elapsed-second glow; it does not infer hostility from creature type or faction. Alignment Sense retains its source-defined rank-1 redundancy as an open balance question. [Review status](DIVINATION_RANK1_REVIEW_STATUS.json) records manuscript scope; no full information/roll-system runtime or human balance is certified.
